summary: vod2pod-rss is a self-hosted tool that converts video streams from platforms like YouTube and Twitch into standard audio podcast feeds. It performs on-the-fly transcoding of video-on-demand content into MP3 format at 192kbps while generating a compatible RSS feed. This allows users to listen to video creators using standard podcast applications without needing to store media files locally.
goodFor: It is a practical solution if you want to consume video-based content purely as audio on mobile podcast clients without manual file downloads.
watchOut: The software carries an at-risk maintenance status, meaning long-term support and timely updates for upstream platform changes may be uncertain.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, it typically requires persistent storage for configuration or caching and a reverse proxy to handle external TLS termination.
